annual-term-no-self-serve.options_intro: Seats are fixed for the length of an annual term, so there is one self-serve answer and one that needs a conversation.
annual-term-no-self-serve.add_note: Extra seats on an annual term are added to your contract rather than bought in the app. Reply to this email and we will send an amended order form the same day, billed pro rata to the end of the term.
